parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch button made of ABS plastic, typically rectangular and slightly raised for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for toggling the electrical circuit on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the switch, made of durable polycarbonate material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components, securing the switch to the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
